consequence.statement: The Cilium Envoy DaemonSet is enabled by default, adding one Pod per Node; Nodes at maximum Pod capacity will see one non-system-critical Pod evicted after upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Set upgradeCompatibility to 1.15 or earlier to keep the previous behavior, or set envoy.enabled explicitly.

assertion.statement: The Helm value envoy.enabled now defaults to enabled when unspecified for new installs (previously false); existing clusters should set upgradeCompatibility to 1.15 or earlier to keep the old behavior, otherwise one extra Pod per Node is added.
